source: A TEST FIXTURE: rows copied from a working catalogue, for the Python tests that need a species' facts as input. The app ships no catalogue; the user's library holds theirs.
note: Mature planning dimensions in metres, with evidence and uncertainty. Generic entries require identification. Generated models remain approximations.
cat_safe_note: This catalog is not a veterinary source. True means linked ASPCA evidence at the stated taxon scope; false known toxic; NULL unverified / not assessed. No extrapolation across genera. Cultivars and essential oils are separate questions.

Density, skirt and tint fixed; still generated geometry, not a scan.

plants.note: Thick green spoon leaves with dense white hairs and red tips; branching offset rosettes. Moderate irrigation in an exceptionally well-drained sunny/filtered-light succulent pocket; allow soil to dry between watering. California growers describe roughly .05–.13 m foliage, with taller flower stalks; .20 m flowering planning example is not a maximum on offset spread.

cat_safety.note: Mountain Crest nursery labels the exact cultivar pet-safe, but no exact ASPCA/veterinary poison-control confirmation was found. Nursery evidence alone does not meet this project’s stronger safety requirement; retain unknown.

size_evidence.note: Surreal gives 20 × 20 cm mature dimensions (description about 15 cm); Ottershaw gives 15–25 cm mature head at five years, distinct from 9 cm sale pot. California growers describe 2–5 or 3–5 inch foliage, 7–8 inch rosette. Retain .20 × .20 m flowering planning example, distinguish lower foliage and indefinite offsets.
